critical_issues: 25% penalty of remaining fee if Client terminates (up to $19,500)
Liability capped at full contract value ($78,000)
Overages capped at $15,000 but scope definition may be unclear
Vendor selection responsibility without warranty of vendor performance
strengths: Clear phased structure with defined deliverables
rationale: The 25% termination fee and $26,000 upfront payment create significant risk. Liability cap of $78,000 exposes consultant to full contract value. However, realistic disclaimers about ROI and vendor performance are good protections.
required_changes: Eliminate or reduce termination penalty to 10%
Add clearer scope boundaries to prevent overage disputes
